dataset.distribution: Deterministic indexed keys; no external dataset

duration.mode: Google Benchmark minimum run time per case

checks: Category joins retain the requested category

semantics.operation: Equal single-request Entity API create, read, update and delete on disjoint keys, shuffled with a seeded PRNG.
semantics.measurement_includes: Client HTTP calls, scheduling and response status/write-envelope checks; final-state and measured-read validation follow measurement.

dataset.kind: Synthetic entities in a unique owned collection
dataset.load_records: 3 times records per operation, with readback

concurrency.arrival_model: Closed-loop bounded in-flight requests; seeded submission order does not fix concurrent completion order.

duration.mode: Fixed operation count; no fixed wall-time or arrival rate

checks: Measured response status and write envelopes
Measured reads and all final states
correctness.publication: Only after validation and cleanup succeed; timed-out writes may still commit after cleanup.

metrics.per_operation_percentiles: p50 median; p95/p99 nearest-rank only with at least 20/100 samples per operation
metrics.process_resources: Optional client and selected server phase snapshots and CPU/process-I/O deltas; unavailable counters are null.

environment.endpoint: Caller-selected HTTP(S) origin; use a dedicated configured server
environment.server_pid: Optional; requires psutil and a local numeric loopback listener owned by the selected PID
environment.authentication: Optional bearer token via environment variable
environment.build_and_hardware: Capture independently; server configuration and rate limits affect results.

evidence_outputs.availability: Published after successful validation and cleanup; contains workload_id and configurable records/concurrency.
Client when available; server only with verified --server-pid. Endpoint snapshots are not phase memory peaks.
Not emitted; capture revision, build, hardware and full configuration separately.

limitations: Not a reference workload, transaction, AQL, multi-node or restart-durability test.
